missions.title: Save the birthday cake
missions.hint: Stop 16 Goonks. Each escape takes a slice! Thieves steal sugar; blue-hat tinkerers share helmets; banana-throwing jesters swap places, then dash to steal your weapon. Tap the thief — Pink slaps them and takes it back.

missions.title: Quiet, please!
missions.hint: Stop 16 singers with golden bells. Escaped singers raise the noise. Stop the helpers before they cause trouble.

missions.title: The giant conductor
missions.hint: A giant conductor takes over the table! Red lanes warn of an attack. Hit the golden crystal above his head or fists before the countdown ends.

missions.title: The donut detectives
missions.hint: Find 12 impostors with black moustaches. Leave the green bow ties alone. A wrong accusation costs a heart!

missions.title: Crack the costume party
missions.hint: Break 16 porcelain helmets. One hit breaks a helmet; its frightened owner stays. Tinkerers can hand out fresh helmets.

missions.title: The neon riot
missions.hint: The punk giant crashes the stage! Dodge his rhythm: hit golden crystals on his head and fists, and stop the small helpers between attacks.

quickBites.title: Speedy snacker
quickBites.description: Eat and charge sugar 50% faster while resting.

ricochet.title: Bouncy mallet
ricochet.description: A hammer kill bounces to one other Goonk. Leaves innocent guests alone.

laser.title: Crystal ray
laser.description: Hold a 3D ray gun with 50 shots each round. Each shot pierces one target’s helmet.

comfort.title: Comfort stitches
comfort.description: Recover 16 health now and block the first damage each round.

longRush.title: Sugar afterglow
longRush.description: Donut frenzy and Sugar Rush last 3 seconds longer.

hammer.title: Golden mallet
hammer.description: Equip a gold hammer. Boss weak spots take double damage.

extraTime.title: One more bite
extraTime.description: Add 10 seconds to every following mission.

cakeShield.title: Birthday insurance
cakeShield.description: Gain 2 extra cake slices and halve escape damage.

bounty.title: Confetti jackpot
bounty.description: Every Goonk earns double points and coins. Heal 2 health per kill.
